== Course of events ==

Tip suggests restuffing the Scarecrow with the money found in the nest, money the Jackdaws had stolen from towns over the years. Following this suggestion, the group refills the Scarecrow with bills of various denominations, restoring his form using the hoarded currency the Jackdaws had gathered.
